body:
Setting.: 2 males 29 and 30 years old
Drugs: 7,5 mg 2cd, 40 mg mxp and 40 mg mxe
T=0: 7,5 mg 2cd ingested. 15 mg dissolved in 3 ml tequila and 1,5 ml was poured into a soda drink.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
T=0.25: In the car to my homie's place. I told him how bizarre it is that I trust his driving skills that much that I always feel confident with him as a driver. Effects already noticeable. Definitely colour enhancement. We laugh about the red glow of the car in front of us. His back lights lighten up the road in a beautiful way.
T=0,5h: we arrived at his place. I play the guitar while he is making dinner. I feel very creative. Definitely great nootropic and social substance. Talking with his girlfriend goes smooth while playing some chord progressions.
T=0,5-1h: Eating was wonderful. Very happy and laughter was abundant. Taste intensified and very cosy mood. This drug is awesome in low doses. Not tripping, but appreciation for the world around you and the social setting is enhanced.
T=1,5: We decided to take it up a notch and dose threshold dose of mxp 40 mg in gelcap. First time we took this drug therefore the low dose to try it out.
T=2,5 h: I knew from tripreports that mxp may take 2h to come up and considering the low dose we take 20 mg mxe in rizla paper and start the movie Primer.
T=3h: My friend thinks I understand this movie due to my science background, but I conclude this low budget movie is made for physic students only. Soon after we quit this movie. Nice mellow mxe mood, damn I love this drug! Definitely a small amplification by the 2cd and/or mxp can be noticed. Not more visual activity yet, but the mxe feels stronger on the body and brain than usual at the same dose. We weigh another 20mg mxe cause we feel like this evening gonna be a journey into space :)
T:4h: We start the movie the Wall (about creatures attacking the Chinese wall). Melting into the couch and completely zen mindstate. Not tripping balls but typical mxe visual distortions, hard to explain :p
T=4: My friend thinks lying on a matrass will be better considering the melt, floaty feeling. Mxe still coming up but nothing unexpected. Mesmerized by the movie. Damn this reminds us of Dynasty Warriors. We wonder when the first musou attack will occur :)
T:4,5: Holy shit!! The mxp adds a feather-like, clear-headed feeling within me, while everything around me is beyond comprehension. The movie is an experience of multiple dimensions. I feel I am holing anytime soon. The battles in the movie and the attacks seemed controllable like playing dynasty warriors on the PS3. Awesome!
T=5-6: Mxe still coming up... Tripping balls! Everything feels and looks 2D. Nicotine enhances the feeling extremely. When we lay on the matras I feel like only my conscience is left. I feel like I am completely flat and parallel to the ground spreaded through the room, which seemed enormous. Warm, euphoric feeling. Giggly and very satisfied. The battles in the movie are mindblowing. I never tripped this hard, but no body load or the slightest fear or discomfort is noticed whatsoever.
T=6-7,5: Movie ended. I wanted to share my spiritual experience with astral projection guided meditation under the influence of dissociatives. I start the YouTube soundfile 'Journey to the sun'. Holing instantly traveling through space and time and feeling great. Undescribable how the astral projection music can be felt through my entire body. Even though it is not ideal when not wearing Sleepphones because the music is more on the background and the voice is not as upfront, but still it is amazing.
T=7,5-8,5: Peak has passed. I felt like taking some ketamine but I left this at home. But felt so connected to my friend that I didn't want to leave to get it. We talk about the spiritual experience my friend had and he told it was similar to the hypnotherapy session he experienced earlier that day. I was sincerely happy for him considering the hard time he experienced last months. We talk a bit but he is in between sleep and awoken state. I smoke another sigaret and decided to crash there on the matras. I start the astral projection 'the Crystal Lake' and slowly drift into space
T=12: Wake up almost sober. My friend has moved to his bedroom to experience a more comfortable sleeping experience. I went home to get some extra 3h sleep before going to a work team building event.
Conclusion: this was an amazing experience.
I would do this again soon but will wait a week or two because I like the dissociative compounds a bit too much:p Feel very calm and relaxed the whole day after. A small headache later on that day. but nothing paracetamol cant fix.
